content: The billing page throws a 504 gateway timeout whenever our accounting team tries to export PDF invoices.
Team invite emails are not being delivered to users with custom subdomains or plus-addressing.
Our SAML SSO integration with Okta started failing after the weekend certificate rollover.
We need to update our primary company credit card but the payment modal is unresponsive on Firefox.
Can we increase our REST API rate limits from 60 to 300 requests per minute for our nightly data sync?
Customer support rep helped us debug our webhook secret verification in less than five minutes. Excellent service!
Weekly Voice-of-Customer email digest was dispatched twice this morning to all administrators.
Cannot delete an obsolete theme category because it is still linked to archived feedback records.
User role changes from Viewer to Analyst are taking over ten minutes to reflect in the active browser session.
The CSV export button is disabled when filtering across more than three distinct tags simultaneously.
The new dashboard layout on iPad is stunning and loads twice as fast as the previous build!
FaceID login fails intermittently on iOS 17.4 forcing manual password entry every morning.
App crashes immediately upon opening the VoC executive summary report when offline in airplane mode.
Clean dark-mode aesthetic and super smooth chart interactions. Easily the best mobile triage tool we use.
Push notifications for negative sentiment spikes are delayed by three hours on Android 14.
Would love an iOS home screen widget that displays today's feedback volume and top trending theme.
The pull-to-refresh animation occasionally stutters when reloading large feedback lists.
Biometric fingerprint authentication works instantly on Pixel 8. Very convenient for quick updates.
Font size in the feedback detail card does not respect the system dynamic text accessibility setting.
Incredible tool for tracking product sentiment on the go during customer conferences.
NPS 10/10: The Ask LOOP grounded Q&A is like having a full-time customer research analyst on demand.
NPS 8/10: Web dashboard is exceptionally powerful but we still need automated Slack alert integrations.
NPS 3/10: Frustrated by frequent 504 timeouts when downloading monthly VAT invoices.
NPS 9/10: Automated theme clustering saved our product team dozens of hours during sprint planning.
NPS 5/10: The tool works well on desktop but mobile triage requires significant improvements.
NPS 10/10: Executive VoC reports format cleanly for our executive leadership meetings without manual editing.
NPS 4/10: Onboarding tutorial skipped team permission setup which caused initial confusion.
NPS 9/10: Multi-tenant workspace isolation and RBAC controls satisfied all our security requirements.
NPS 6/10: Product is good overall but pricing tiers should be clearer regarding included viewer seats.
NPS 10/10: Fastest customer feedback platform we have evaluated. Highly recommended for growth teams.
Prospect call with VP of Engineering at FinCorp: Deal blocked on SAML SSO support and SOC2 compliance report.
Live demo reaction: Head of Product loved the Ask LOOP citation mechanism and zero-hallucination guardrails.
Churn risk alert: Customer CTO mentioned they will churn next quarter unless direct Snowflake sync is added.
Expansion opportunity: Client requested 20 additional Analyst seats if custom theme grouping is delivered.
Lost deal debrief: Prospect selected competitor because LOOP does not yet offer native Zapier connectors.
QBR feedback: VP of CX reported a 35% reduction in customer escalation triage time using spike detection.
Procurement security questionnaire: European subsidiary requires GDPR data residency guarantees in Frankfurt.
Demo follow-up: Head of Support praised the simulated Zendesk ingest button for rapid team onboarding.
Executive check-in: CFO highlighted that LOOP insights identified onboarding churn friction saving $15k MRR.
Closed-won enterprise contract: Signed $75k annual commitment citing multi-tenancy and RBAC governance.
Loving the clean dark mode layout! Finally a B2B SaaS tool that looks like it was designed this decade.
Has anyone configured automated webhook ingestion from Typeform into LOOP via a custom serverless worker?
Just imported our historical survey responses using the CSV uploader. 500 rows parsed in two seconds flat.
Feature request: Can we get keyboard shortcuts for changing feedback status between NEW, REVIEWED, and ACTIONED?
The Ask LOOP grounded citations are super accurate — it cited an obscure review from our beta test last month.
Getting intermittent CORS errors when calling the feedback API from our custom client-side feedback widget.
Would love a Figma community widget that displays live customer feedback quotes beside design canvases.
Kudos to the engineering team for 100% uptime over our busiest Black Friday shopping weekend.
Weekly VoC digests have completely replaced our manual customer insight presentation decks.
Zero regrets migrating to LOOP. The role permissions allow our junior analysts to triage without any security risk.
